daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum Analysis with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical stock price data, calculate a 30-day rolling average price and identify momentum shifts for each stock. Write a query using window functions (AVG() OVER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER) to: (1) compute the 30-day moving average for each stock ordered by date, (2) rank stocks by their price change percentage in the last 7 days, (3) flag stocks where the current price crosses above/below the 30-day MA. Return stock symbol, date, close price, 30-day MA, price change %, and rank. Use a CTE to organize the window function logic cleanly.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning and Feature Engineering
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (injury crashes from the past 3 years). Use pandas to: (1) clean the dataset by handling missing values in severity, location, and vehicle type columns, (2) standardize datetime formats for crash dates, (3) create new features: time_of_day (peak vs off-peak hours), crash_type (multi-vehicle vs single), and location_category (urban vs rural based on postal code mapping), (4) remove duplicates and validate data integrity. Export the cleaned dataset to a new CSV file. Document any data quality issues found and your handling decisions in comments.

daily_quests.title: COVID-19 Vaccination Progress Dashboard Data Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a mini ETL pipeline: (1) In Python, fetch and clean the COVID-19 Australia vaccination dataset (handle missing states, date formatting, and vaccination type inconsistencies), (2) load the cleaned data into a local SQLite database with appropriate schema (state, date, vaccine_type, doses_administered, population_eligible), (3) in SQL, write queries to calculate: cumulative vaccination rates by state, weekly dose administration trends using window functions, and states lagging behind the national average. (4) Export final analytical results to CSV. Combine both scripts into a single Python file that orchestrates the entire pipeline with error handling and logging.
